title: TOKYO VLOG 🇯🇵🗼✨ Best Cafes, Sushi Omakase, Thrifting in Harajuku & MORE..
description:
✨ Check out Nourish using the link: http://usenourish.com/juanmarcelandrhylan and book your first appointment in under 5 minutes!!

In this 2026 Tokyo, Japan Travel Vlog we bring you with us for 48 hours of exploring, eating & shopping our way through our favorite city in the world, Tokyo. We visit new cafes like the super cool Coffee Swamp vinyl cafe, have a peaceful morning walk in Meiji Shrine (Meiji Jingu), try the iconic Wagyu beef sandwiches from Grill Bon, go shopping in the MASSIVE 12-story Uniqlo flagship store in Ginza, show you the super cool Shinjuku apartment we are staying in, visit our favorite cafe in Tokyo (Bongen Coffee), experience our first ever Sushi omakase at the incredible Sushiya, have the best Matcha in Tokyo at Cloud Club, wander around Takeshita street, vintage shop in Harajuku and have some of the best Udon noodles ever in Shibuya Scramble!!
